dc:title: MP_dates
dc:description: MP_dates is provided in csv and rds formats in /data/processed. This dataset includes detailed information on membership timelines of MPs in Folketinget. Refer to the documentation for more details.

columns.name: period_id
columns.dc:title: Membership Period ID
columns.dc:description: Unique identifier for each membership period

columns.name: surname
columns.dc:title: Surname(s)
columns.dc:description: Surname(s) of the MP. Names are spelled according to standardised orthography and, in terms of morphology, in nominative (Faroese) resp. absolutive (Greenlandic) case

columns.name: first_name
columns.dc:title: First Name(s)
columns.dc:description: First Name(s) of the MP. Names are spelled according to standardised orthography and, in terms of morphology, in nominative (Faroese) resp. absolutive (Greenlandic) case

columns.name: MP_id
columns.dc:title: MP ID
columns.dc:description: Each MP is assigned an ID by Folketingets åbne data service (ODA). Each MP_id thus is a unique identifier for one member of Folketinget

columns.name: origin
columns.dc:title: Origin
columns.dc:description: Geographical origin of the MP, using ISO 3166-2 codes

columns.name: party
columns.dc:title: Party
columns.dc:description: Political Party the MP is member of at the time of this vote, using the common abbreviation for Greenlandic Parties and the party letter code (Bogstavsbetegnelse) for Faroese parties

columns.name: start
columns.dc:title: Start Date
columns.dc:description: Date of the beginning of a parliamentary membership period

columns.name: end
columns.dc:title: End Date
columns.dc:description: Date of the end of parliamentary membership period

columns.name: substitute
columns.dc:title: Substitute MP
columns.dc:description: Boolean indicating whether the MP served Folketinget as a substitute member for another MP who went on leave
